Depending on its size, each tenant has access to a set amount of CPU resources allocated for
running advanced hunting queries. For detailed information about various usage parameters,
read about advanced hunting quotas and usage parameters.
After running your query, you can see the execution time and its resource usage (Low, Medium,
High). High indicates that the query took more resources to run and could be improved to
return results more efficiently.
Customers who run multiple queries regularly should track consumption and apply the
optimization guidance in this article to minimize disruption resulting from exceeding quotas or
usage parameters.
